parameters.reason: 3,950 patients remain locked out, with highest impact on SMS-only and over-65 users; call centre queue is 95 minutes and is not listed as a fallback in current procedures

parameters.basis: fraud-model alert flagging credential stuffing; no confirmed unauthorised login; investigation incomplete

parameters.incident: OTP failure spike and mass automated lockouts affecting patient access
parameters.impact: 3,950 patients remain locked out; highest among SMS-only and over-65 users

decision.rationale: Patients remain unable to access the digital service, with disproportionate impact on SMS-only and older users. I propose activating a fallback channel through the call centre under my business-continuity authority, while noting the call centre is not currently listed as a fallback and queue time is 95 minutes. I also propose reviewing the automated lockouts because the fraud-model alert is suspected, not proven, and no unauthorised login has been confirmed. I will notify health data oversight and share the confirmed access-impact fact with the public access inclusion role.

citations.quote_span: 4.18.1. Entities must establish breach/incidence response management (Incident Response and Business Continuity) and recovery (Incident Recovery and Disaster Recovery) plans that comprise of:
citations.relevance: Standing obligation to maintain incident response and business continuity plans, supporting activation of a fallback access channel while patients remain locked out.

citations.quote_span: 6. Human Oversight: The Charter emphasizes the irreplaceable value of human judgment and human oversight over AI, aligning with ethical values and social standards to correct any errors or biases that may arise.
citations.relevance: Supports human review of the fraud-model lockout alert before reversing automated lockouts, since the alert is suspected, not proven.

citations.quote_span: 4.18.2. Entities must thoroughly investigate the breaches/incidents starting from the point of discovery until closure: aa.. Determine if the breach is related to a violation of PHI.
citations.relevance: Supports reviewing automated lockouts as part of incident investigation from discovery until closure.

citations.quote_span: 4.18.4. The Entity is required to report breaches/incidents within the designated period defined by Executive Regulations of UAE Data Protection Law.
citations.relevance: Supports notifying health data oversight of the incident and access impact.

uncertainty: Whether the call centre has authority to act as an authentication fallback under portal procedures
Whether the fraud-model alert reflects an actual credential-stuffing attack
Whether any patient account was actually accessed without authorisation
The designated breach reporting period under the PDPL Executive Regulations, which is not in the reviewed corpus
